english.title: Exhibit false notice of entry in respect of pharmacist
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), exhibited a notice which purported to be a notice of entry issued under article 26 of the Pharmacy Order 2010 in respect of **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a pharmacist, but which was not a notice of entry issued under that article in respect of that pharmacist
english.legislation: Contrary to article 38(5)(a) and (9) of the Pharmacy Order 2010.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant exhibited a notice which purported to be a notice of entry issued under article 26 of the Pharmacy Order 2010 in respect of **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a pharmacist, but which was not a notice of entry issued under that article in respect of that pharmacist.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex, see Article 38(10)Note
Article 38(10) states: Proceedings for an offence under this article may be begun at any time within the period of 6 months beginning with the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Council to justify a prosecution came to the Council's knowledge; but no proceedings may be begun after the expiry of the period of two years beginning with the date of the commission of the offence.
